name: L-Train | 2g Moonrock Blunt | Grape Escape
description:
Elevate your smoking experience to celestial heights with our premium Moonrock style Infused Blunt. Crafted for connoisseurs who seek that perfect balance between potency and f lavor, this exquisite blunt is a harmonious fusion of top-tier cannabis flower, pure THC distillate, and powdered kief all wrapped in our 100% tobacco free hemp Blunts. Enjoy a burst of flavor and a senses of cultural nostalgia with every puff!

Bursting with the rich, juicy essence of ripe grapes, this premium blunt offers a smooth and delightful smoking experience. Each puff delivers a sweet, fruity flavor that tantalizes your taste buds and provides an Energizing yet stress relieving escape from your day. Perfectly crafted for those who appreciate a day time boost, flavorful smoke, our Grape Escape Blunt is your ticket to a sweet and satisfying adventure.
